brief: Write `count_down(n)` that returns a list counting down from n to 1, inclusive, using a while loop.
starterCode:
def count_down(n):
    result = []
    # your code here
    return result
solutionCode:
def count_down(n):
    result = []
    i = n
    while i > 0:
        result.append(i)
        i -= 1
    return result

attacks.message: The While Wraith stalls your clock — the loop condition never flips.
Frozen solid. Your while loop never ends.

tests.label: Returns an empty list when n = 0

hintCards.title: While loop condition
hintCards.body: The loop keeps running while its condition is true. To count down to 1, the condition should be `i > 0`, not `i >= 0`.

hintCards.title: Accumulator pattern, again
hintCards.body: Start with an empty list, append inside the loop, then decrement.
